messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — VP of Product at MistralRetail just pushed a hard deadline for the POC. They want dedicated throughput and an SLA for 3-week pilot. Legal + Finance flagged pricing and data residency. Can we mobilize an exec-level decision today?
Maya Patel: Details on throughput + model?
Alex Kim: Asking for sustained 250 rps, 4x A100 equiv, 99th pct <200ms. Wants EU data residency and KMS. Finance asked for a committed discount (20% for a 6mo follow-on).
Jon Rivera: 250 rps sustained for that latency will require Dedicated. We can propose Dedicated + burst. Canary rollout to hosted variants is an option if provisioning takes longer.
Emily Chen: VPC peering + private KMS will take infra effort. ETA: VPC peering 48hrs if all network creds landed today. KMS integration + attestation ~5 business days.
Priya Shah: If KMS is 5 days, customer may push back. Do we have an interim compliance answer?
Jon Rivera: Short-term workaround: host POC in Hosted EU region and enforce strict retention + no-export policy. Not ideal for their security team but often passes initial reviews.
Maya Patel: Legal already said "no-export" is borderline for them. They explicitly asked whether Private deployment (VPC) is possible.
Alex Kim: They made it clear — if we can't do VPC+BYO-KMS for POC, they will move to competitor. Need exec signoff on either: 1) commit 20% discount + rapid Dedicated provisioning, or 2) offer 15% + accelerated hosted with strict controls.
Priya Shah: I'm going to escalate to CRO + CTO. Which artifacts do you need for the exec brief?
Maya Patel: One-pager with: POC acceptance criteria, cost delta between 15%/20%, up-front infra timeline, list of legal sign-offs and outstanding items. Also include risk of losing deal if delayed.
Jon Rivera: I'll attach proposed smoke test plan and resource estimate (4 GPUs, 2x workers, autoscale threshold).
Emily Chen: I'll open infra ticket and attach network checklist. Ticket: INF-12345 created. Will update with CI/CD runbook.
Ops Bot: Created ticket INF-12345 for VPC peering and KMS onboarding. Assigned to Emily Chen.
Priya Shah: Can someone confirm the maximum discount authority? I can approve up to 12% without CRO. Anything above needs CRO signoff.
Alex Kim: Customer is firm on 20%. CRO needs to weigh strategic value — this is a reference-name target in EU with potential ARR >$2M.
Maya Patel: I'll draft the exec one-pager and include the cost math. Can someone paste current list price + committed price tiers?
Jon Rivera: Pricing sheet link: https://redwood.example/pricing — committed tiers tab. Quick math: baseline POC projected infra $18k over 3 weeks; 20% discount saves $3.6k — but long-term ARR makes it sensible.
Priya Shah: CRO, @CRO — pinging for quick decision. We need either a hard "yes" on 20% or guidance to offer 12% + accelerated hosted workaround. :eyes:
thread_summary: Escalation for MistralRetail POC: customer demands VPC + KMS and a 20% committed discount. Infra ETA for VPC 48hrs, KMS 5 days. Sales needs exec signoff on discount or permission to offer hosted workaround. Action items: Maya to draft exec brief, Jon to attach smoke test and cost estimate, Emily opened INF-12345, Priya to loop CRO/CTO.
